items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
items.claim: In the text, the LORD speaks to Moses to give him a message.

items.quote: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying,
items.claim: The LORD says he has heard the children of Israel complaining, and tells Moses to pass his answer on to them.
items.action: heard the murmurings of; instructs Moses to speak unto
items.mechanism: divine response to popular complaint, relayed through Moses

items.quote: At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread;
items.claim: The LORD promises the children of Israel meat in the evening and enough bread in the morning.
items.object: flesh at even and bread in the morning

items.quote: and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God.
items.claim: The text gives the reason for the food: so the children of Israel will know that the LORD is their God.
items.object: the children of Israel's knowledge that he is the LORD their God
items.mechanism: provision as proof of divine identity
